title: Debate assessment criteria
subject: History
unit: Spring 2: The history of technology (Tomorrow's World)
source: Written for history/y6 lesson 13 (Debate assessment criteria (portal printable; assessed))
intro: Lesson 13: The debate and our unit review. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

parts.text: List the strongest point on each side

keywords.def: a formal discussion where two sides argue
look back at what we learned

questions.q: Give the strongest point you heard from the other side.
questions.a: Any accurate point from the debate

questions.q: Core: Take part in the debate: deliver your planned points and at least one rebuttal (assessed debate contribution).
questions.a: Clear points with evidence; respectful turn-taking

questions.q: Extend: In the portal response box, write your final judgement in one paragraph.
questions.a: A balanced judgement with evidence from both sides
B) The best evidence. Judges weigh evidence and reasoning.

questions.q: A good debate judge decides on:
Big question: does technology make the world better?
questions.a: A reasoned judgement: often better when used wisely, with real risks to manage
